_comment: Which of the GAME's own sprites stands for which errand on «Таймеры» (#2019).
The stems are the client's own file names, extracted by tools/extract_errand_icons.py
into results/errand_icons/ (git-ignored — the art never leaves the machine that owns
the game). An errand that is not named here draws no picture at all, which is the
honest answer: a wrong icon is worse than none.
THE TAVERN NAMES THE BUILDING ITSELF (#2061, «выведи картинку здания таверны»): the
beer mug that stood here was a stand-in and the person asked for the building. The
client has no small ICON for a building — its own art is the 3D model — so this is
the flat picture from the building's own help screen, and it appears once that screen
has been opened in the game and the extractor run again. Until then the card draws no
picture, which is what «no stand-in» costs and is the same contract every other
